correctness.rationale: PASS: Two independent descriptions of Kendall tau as pair-order disagreement and adjacent-swap distance agree on all unordered permutation pairs. Every code with 20 elements maps by a symbol relabeling to one containing identity; thus normalized size-20 equality enumeration and no normalized size-21 clique suffice. Reviewed exact color-bounded clique enumeration over 120 permutations and independently replayed a fresh bitset/color-capped clique search: exactly 532 normalized 20-cliques, no 21-clique. Double count (code, selected word) yields N=532*120/20=3192; expansion under all 120 relabelings and reversal gives orbit profile 1*6+3*30+2*48+4*60+5*120+9*240=3192 and 24 orbits. Claimed symmetry is only the explicit 240 group; finite search is exhaustive for its fully specified 120-vertex graph.

limitations: Finite exactly S5 at distance>=3, not an all-n coding bound.
